title: docsrs-cli dry-run success envelope fragment
description: When global --dry-run is set on a network command, success envelopes include dry_run=true and data with planned_url plus planned_params. Where planned_params names a crate at all it uses crate_name and never crate, which covers readme, get-item and search-in-crate; search-crates plans a query instead and its planned_params carry q, per_page, sort, page and page_token, with no crate_name. For get-item associated-item dry-run, planned_params may also include validation=url_shape_only, planned_parent_kind, parent_kind_probe, and planned_method_anchors (associated-item specific; not required).

agent_surface.description: Reduction report, attached beside data whenever a reduction knob is active. A dry-run combined with --select, --filter, --max-items, --sort, --dedupe-by, --count-only or --truncate-content carries it, so an envelope that forbade it would reject a valid reply. See agent-surface.schema.json for the shape.

planned_params.description: Command-specific planned fields; crate fields use crate_name. search-in-crate planned limit is clamped to 1000 even if --limit is higher. Keys vary by command, so additionalProperties remains true only on this bag. For get-item associated-item dry-run (Parent::member paths of kind method, type or const), optional keys include validation (url_shape_only), planned_parent_kind, parent_kind_probe (array of kind strings) and planned_method_anchors; these are associated-item specific and not required.

validation.description: Present on get-item associated-item dry-run: plan validates URL shape only (does not verify remote existence).

planned_parent_kind.description: Present on get-item associated-item dry-run: first parent kind used to build planned_url (live fetch may probe the remaining kinds). Leads with the kind that hosts the member category: trait for associated types, struct for methods and associated constants.

parent_kind_probe.description: Present on get-item associated-item dry-run: ordered parent kind strings live fetch may probe on 404. Order varies by member category.

planned_method_anchors.description: Present on get-item associated-item dry-run: ordered rustdoc anchor ids the live fetch will try. planned_url can carry only one fragment, but rustdoc emits one id prefix per member category and they coexist on the parent page: method.NAME for inherent and defaulted methods, tymethod.NAME for required trait methods, associatedtype.NAME for associated types, associatedconstant.NAME for associated constants. Field name kept for wire compatibility with 1.2.1.
